title: Quiz: Migrations and Schema Evolution
description: Check your understanding of Migrations and Schema Evolution.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: Why never edit an already-applied migration?
questions.correctAnswer: Environments track applied versions — edits cause drift and failures

questions.question: True or False: Applied migrations are immutable history; write a new one instead.
What is the main purpose of the Migrations and Schema Evolution technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you migrations and schema evolution effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
